app.name: Assistigo
app.tagline: India's AI form-filling assistant for CSCs and cyber cafes

auth.consentRequired: Please accept the terms to continue.

auth.checkEmail: Check your email to confirm your account.

brand.badge: AI form autofill for Indian portals
brand.headlineLead: Save a customer once, then fill any form in
brand.subtitle: Assistigo reads Indian documents, keeps every profile in one place, and fills supported portals after you review each field.
brand.pointProfiles: One customer profile reused across every form
brand.pointExtract: Details extracted from photos and PDFs
brand.pointReview: Nothing is submitted without your review
brand.privacyNote: Aadhaar numbers are never stored in full.

onboarding.title: Set up your centre
onboarding.subtitle: This takes about a minute. You can change everything later.
onboarding.monthlyForms: Roughly how many forms do you fill each month?

dashboard.title: Today at your centre
dashboard.timeSavedHint: Based on {fields} fields filled this month
dashboard.emptyCustomers: No customers yet. Add your first one to get started.

customers.title: Customers
customers.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, mobile, customer code, village or district
customers.name: Name
customers.duplicateWarning: This looks like an existing customer
customers.duplicateHelp: Check before creating a second record for the same person.
customers.confirmDelete: Delete this customer? This can be reversed by a manager.
customers.editHelp: Change any field below and save. Leaving a field blank keeps its current value — it will not be cleared.
customers.editKeepEncrypted: Leave blank to keep the saved value
customers.editSetEncrypted: Leave blank if none, or type a value to save

paste.title: Add customer details
paste.help: Paste a customer’s details as text — from a portal, an email, a spreadsheet or a message. Assistigo reads it into profile fields. Nothing is saved until you review it.
paste.placeholder:
Name: Amit Kumar
Father’s Name: Ram Kumar
Date of Birth: 14/08/1996
Mobile: 9900012345
District: Ghazipur
paste.privacyNote: The pasted text is read and discarded — it is not stored. Aadhaar numbers are removed automatically; only the last four digits are kept.
paste.readLines: Found {fields} fields in {lines} lines. Check each one before saving.
paste.noFields: No profile fields could be read from this text. Try one detail per line, like “Mobile: 9900012345”.
paste.prefillHelp: Paste the customer’s details and Assistigo will fill this form. Check every value before saving.
paste.prefillExtra: {count} more details were found — paste the same text on the profile after saving to add them.
paste.uploadIntro: Upload an ID, certificate or marksheet. Assistigo reads it and proposes profile fields the same way pasted text does.
paste.uploadedHelp: Assistigo is reading it now. It will appear in Documents below — review and save the details from there once reading finishes.

warnings.noText: There was nothing to read in that text.
warnings.noFieldsFound: No profile fields could be read from this text.
warnings.noNameFound: No name could be read from this text.
warnings.aadhaarRemoved: An Aadhaar number was found and removed. Only the last four digits can be stored.
warnings.textTruncated: The text was very long, so only the first part was read.

settings.title: Settings
settings.membersSubtitle: Invite the people who work at your centre and give each of them the least access they need.
settings.lastOwner: An organization must keep at least one owner.

descriptions.owner: Full access, including billing, security and deleting the organization.
descriptions.manager: Runs the centre day to day. Manages staff, customers and applications.
descriptions.operator: Serves customers: profiles, documents, form filling and applications.
descriptions.viewer: Read-only access to customers and applications.
descriptions.billing_admin: Manages the plan and invoices. No access to customer data.

privacy.sensitiveNotice: Sensitive value. Revealing it is recorded in the audit log.
privacy.aadhaarNotice: Assistigo stores only the last four digits of an Aadhaar number.
privacy.demoDataNotice: This workspace contains demo data. Do not enter real customer details.

documents.title: Documents
documents.subtitle: Uploaded documents, extraction status and review.
documents.uploadSubtitle: Assistigo reads the document and proposes profile fields. Nothing is saved until you review it.
documents.emptyDescription: Upload an ID, certificate or marksheet to pull details into a customer profile.
documents.fileHint: JPG, PNG, WEBP or PDF, up to {size}.
documents.typeHint: Optional. Assistigo detects the type and will correct this if needed.
documents.customerHint: Attach the document to a customer so extracted details can be saved to their profile.
documents.deleteConfirm: Delete this document? The stored file is removed permanently.
documents.processingHelp: This usually takes a few seconds. This page updates on its own.
documents.failedHelp: Try uploading a clearer scan, or read it again.

errors.uploadFailed: The file could not be uploaded. Please try again.

warnings.title: Notes on this extraction
warnings.valueNotUnderstood: A value was found but could not be understood, so it was skipped.
warnings.noFieldsFound: No details could be read from this document.
warnings.noNameFound: No name could be read from this document.
warnings.unknownDocumentType: The document type could not be identified. You can set it yourself.
warnings.aiProcessingNotEnabled: AI processing is off for this workspace, so a basic reader was used instead.
warnings.aiProviderNotConfigured: The AI reader is not set up on this system, so the basic reader was used instead.
warnings.aiReadingUsed: This document was read by the AI reader. Check every value against the page.
warnings.aiReadingFailed: The AI reader could not be reached, so the basic reader was used instead. Try reading again in a moment.
warnings.aiNeedsImage: This PDF is a scan with no text in it. The AI reader needs a photo — upload the page as a JPG or PNG.
warnings.aiFileTooLarge: This file is too large to send to the AI reader. Upload a smaller image.
warnings.aiReturnedNoText: The AI reader could not make out any text on this document.
warnings.localCannotReadImages: The basic reader cannot read photos. Choose the AI reader to read this one.
warnings.pdfHasNoText: This PDF is a scan rather than text, so the basic reader found nothing in it. Choose the AI reader, or upload the page as an image.
warnings.unknown: Something about this document needs a second look.

review.title: Review extracted details
review.help: Check each value against the document. Accept, edit or reject — nothing is saved to the profile until you do.
review.noFields: Nothing was extracted from this document.
review.noCustomerHelp: Attach this document to a customer before saving, so the details have somewhere to go.

extractionMode.label: Reading method

hints.auto: Reads the document here first, and only asks the AI reader if that finds nothing.
hints.non_ai: Instant and free. Reads PDFs that already contain text. Cannot read a photo or a scan.
hints.ai: Best for phone photos and scanned certificates. Sends the document to an AI provider.

extractionMode.aiNotice: The AI reader sends this document to an outside AI provider to be read. It only runs if your workspace owner has turned on AI processing.

documentTools.title: Document tools
documentTools.subtitle: Prepare photos, signatures, print sheets and PDFs to a portal’s exact rules.

photoSignature.title: Photo & Signature Studio
photoSignature.description: Crop to a portal preset, clean up a signature, hit an exact KB size.

passportGrid.title: Passport Photo Grid
passportGrid.description: Lay out 4, 8, 12 or 16 photos on 4×6 or A4 paper, ready to cut.

pvcCard.title: PVC Card & Aadhaar Mask
pvcCard.description: Front and back card layout, e-Aadhaar unlock, and identifier masking.

pdfStudio.title: PDF Studio
pdfStudio.description: Merge, split, reorder, rotate and compress to a portal’s size limit.

hub.privacyBody: Every crop, adjustment and page edit happens on this computer. Nothing is sent anywhere until you choose to download the result or save it to a customer’s profile.

drop.orDragPaste: or drag it here, or paste with Ctrl+V

preset.title: Portal preset
preset.hint: Fills in the size and dimensions below. Every number stays editable.
preset.customHint: Set your own dimensions and KB limit below.

rule.title: Size & format
rule.hint: What the finished file will be.
rule.lockAspectHint: Turn off to crop freely, then set a size separately.
rule.pngHint: PNG has no size limit control — use it only when the portal asks for PNG.
rule.pngNoCompression: PNG files cannot be compressed to a target size. Switch to JPG to hit a KB limit.

photo.chooseHint: A clear, well-lit photo works best. JPG, PNG or WEBP.

signature.title: Signature cleanup
signature.hint: For a signature photographed on paper.
signature.cleanHint: Removes shadows and paper tone, keeps the ink.
signature.strengthHint: Higher removes more shadow but can thin a light stroke.
signature.transparentHint: For overlaying the signature on a form or a card, instead of a white box.
signature.keepInkHint: Keeps blue ink blue instead of turning it black.

adjust.title: Adjust
adjust.clarityHint: Stretches a flat, dull scan towards true black and white.

stamp.title: Name & date stamp
stamp.hint: Some portals reject a photo without this printed on it.
stamp.enable: Print name and date on the photo
stamp.name: Name
stamp.privacy: The name is printed on the image only — it is not saved or sent anywhere by Assistigo.

output.title: Result
output.empty: Choose a file to get started.
output.tooLarge: Larger than the portal allows — lower the maximum or simplify the photo
output.saveTo: Save a copy to a customer
output.recipe: What was done to this file

warnings.overLimit: Could not get under the maximum size without a bigger quality loss. Check the result before using it.
warnings.padded: Extra data was added to reach the minimum size. This does not change how the image looks.
warnings.downscaled: The image was shrunk to reach the target size.
warnings.tooLargeToSave: This file is larger than Assistigo’s prepared-file limit and cannot be saved to a customer profile. You can still download it.
warnings.sheetFull: The sheet could not fit every photo requested. Some were left out.

grid.chooseHint: One photo, laid out as many times as fit on the sheet.
grid.howManyHint: Up to {capacity} fit on this sheet at this size.
grid.tooBig: This photo size does not fit on this sheet. Choose a smaller size or a bigger sheet.
grid.gapHint: Leaves room to cut between photos.
grid.cutMarksHint: Small corner ticks to guide the cut.

card.chooseEAadhaarHint: The password-protected PDF downloaded from the UIDAI website.
card.unlockHint: The password is usually the first four letters of the name in capitals, followed by the year of birth (e.g. SURE1990).
card.passwordIncorrect: That password did not work. Check it and try again.
card.documentKind: What kind of document is this?
card.documentKindHint: Aadhaar-class documents must have the number masked before printing or saving.
card.maskRequired: Drag the black box over the number before printing or saving this card. Only the last four digits should stay visible.
card.redactionHandle: Drag to move, corner to resize
card.copiesHint: How many card faces to place on one 4×6 sheet.
card.notice: A masked Aadhaar card shows only the last four digits, matching UIDAI’s own masked-Aadhaar format. The full number is never stored by Assistigo.

pdf.chooseHint: Combine certificates, marksheets or photographed pages into one PDF.
pdf.dragHint: Drag a page to reorder it. Hover a page to rotate or remove it.
pdf.allowRasterise: If needed, redraw pages as images to reach the size limit
pdf.rasteriseOffHint: Without this, a scanned PDF may not be able to reach a very small size limit.
pdf.rasterisedWarning: Pages were redrawn as images to reach the size limit. Text in the PDF is no longer selectable.

errors.decodeFailed: That file could not be opened. Try a different file.
errors.assembleFailed: The PDF could not be put together. Try removing the most recently added page.
